title: Housing ministry raises EWS housing target under PMAY 2.0 by 350%
summary: MoHUA raised BLC PMAY-U 2.0 target to 500,000 homes in FY27 from 110,000 in FY26. Budgetary outlay rose 148% to Rs 18,625 crore.
